extractedWith: tools/extract/extract.ps1 -Batch p5-notifications -Manifest <scratch copy of allowlist.manifest.yaml with the p5-notifications batch> -Clean (staging %TEMP%/codelab-extract/p5-notifications, outside the repo; scrub findings are expected before the rewrite; secret scan clean)
promotion: Each staged file was read as a reference and rewritten with starter names and structure; "target" is the repo file it informed, "stagedTarget" the path in the staging folder. Content is a rewrite, so the repo file hash differs from stagedSha256. No provider credentials, hosts or addresses were carried.

origins.note: Rewritten as the feed use cases (GetNotificationFeed with a before-id cursor and hasMore instead of page numbers, GetUnreadNotificationCount, MarkNotificationRead: ownership-scoped, idempotent, another user’s id is not found) and the kernel INotificationService port (NotifyUserAsync, SendToAddressAsync, SendImmediateEmailAsync). Left behind: i18n-key drafts rendered by the client, role broadcasts and the workflow-specific notify methods; texts are rendered server-side from templates in both languages.

Rewritten as NotificationWriter: renders every asked channel in both languages before writing (a missing text or placeholder refuses), stores the bell texts, then queues one outbox message per pending channel. The guarded swallow-and-log notify methods were not carried: failures are refusals or outbox retries.
Rewritten: one row per key, channel (int flag) and language with a composite key, seeded only by migration; no audit columns, mandatory flag or numeric template ids.
Folded into NotificationTemplate (subject and body per language); the locale table became the kernel AppLanguage enum.

Rewritten as EmailDeliveryOptions and SmsDeliveryOptions with int modes (FileDrop/Smtp, File/Gateway) and start-up validators; no credentials, provider URLs or sender ids; an unknown mode fails start instead of falling back silently.

The logging fakes became real development sinks: FileSmsSender writes JSON lines (and FileDropEmailSender writes .eml files); GatewaySmsSender is a documented stub for phase 8. No provider adapters were carried.

Rewritten as the module-internal IEmailSender and ISmsSender ports (throw on failure so the outbox retries, instead of a success flag swallowed by the caller), EmailMessage and SmsMessage with the language. The provider list call and the error-type catalogue were not carried.

Rewritten for the internal relay: host, port, TLS and timeout from validated options, no user name or password, failures wrapped as UpstreamUnavailableException instead of returned as text. The pickup-folder FileDropEmailSender was added as the development and CI default.

Rewritten: a single {{name}} syntax (generated regex, constants in TemplateTokens) instead of {Key} and (Key); a missing placeholder refuses the text (NOTIFICATIONS_PLACEHOLDER_MISSING) instead of shipping the raw token; values are encoded per channel (HTML for e-mail bodies, one line for subjects).

Read as context only: the gaps it records (swallowed failures, actor locale instead of recipient locale, missing templates, two placeholder syntaxes, separate service with its own key) shaped the module rules, the recipe docs/recipes/add-notification.md and MODULE.md Gotchas. No text carried.
